title: zao execution aggregate result schema
description: Controller-level aggregate result written to result.json in the execution directory at the end of a run. Contains per-step statuses, token usage, and execution-level metadata.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the result was written.

flow_provenance.description: Which config layer provided this flow definition.

overall_success.description: Whether the entire execution succeeded (all steps success or skipped).

error.description: Error message on failure, null on success.

compiled_flow_package_dir.description: Absolute path to the compiled flow package directory inside the execution dir. Contains package.yaml (with derived_from provenance), flow.yaml (with substituted tasks), and roles.yaml (with resolved roles).

id.description: Step identifier from the flow definition.

error.description: Error detail on failure, null otherwise.
